quest.title: Selling Like Hot Carvings
quest.description: Did the kids like new carving? Did Tanger repent? Go to Port Ormos and find out.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Talk to the artisans and Razi

dialogues.speaker: Razi
dialogues.text: The Aranara father owned up to his mistake and was forgiven by his Aranara son...

dialogues.speaker: Razi
dialogues.text: Hmm... I think everyone will like how the story goes, but the reason the father owned up to his mistake was too simple.

dialogues.speaker: Tanger
dialogues.text: Perhaps we could make them go through some kind of hardship together. I'm sure they'll become more understanding of each other that way. The Aranara father will feel guilty after seeing his son work hard.

dialogues.speaker: Razi
dialogues.text: Hmm, when the Aranara father starts feeling guilty, should he speak more slowly, or more quickly?

dialogues.speaker: Tanger
dialogues.text: That depends on the Aranara son. It would be interesting to hear them speak at different paces.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Tanger and Razi, whatcha up to?

dialogues.speaker: Razi
dialogues.text: Dad and I are just discussing our latest story. I'll be the one telling the story this time.

dialogues.speaker: Razi
dialogues.text: But I'm a little nervous about telling a story in front of so many people. That's why I'm asking Dad for advice.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Sumeru's gonna have a new young storyteller.

dialogues.speaker: Tanger
dialogues.text: If it weren't for you, Razi would surely have left me for good.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's so glad everything worked out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... there's still something that doesn't quite add up!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh? What is it? Do you need help investigating something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why would a Mondstadter leave a note in a tree hollow deep in the Avidya Forest?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I—I thought we moved on from this topic! Um... it was just a coincidence!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: A lot of people write down their secrets and hide them in tree hollows! It's not a big deal at all...

choices.text: Collei looks kinda flustered all of a sudden.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I have my secrets and troubles too. And... I tell them to tree hollows.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But seeing Razi and Tanger has given me an idea:

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, could you be my tree hollow?

dialogues.speaker: Qasit
dialogues.text: Aww... I got the same one again. When will I get the chubby, squishy one...

dialogues.speaker: Qasit
dialogues.text: I guess I'll just have to save up my allowance and get them all.

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: Huh...? I thought you came here every day! Have you still not collected them all yet?

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: You should've gotten them as a set. That way, you get seven different designs at once.

dialogues.speaker: Qasit
dialogues.text: But then there's no surprise...

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: Surprises are boring! I want to have every design there is! That's what you do when you really love something.

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: I've finally saved up enough to buy the set today.

dialogues.speaker: Mamdouh
dialogues.text: I'm very sorry, but the one Qasit bought was our very last carving. We're out of stock today.

dialogues.speaker: Mamdouh
dialogues.text: But, we're working on expanding our team, so please check back tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Alia
dialogues.text: Fine, I'll come back tomorrow. Hmph, just so you know, Aranara carvings are more than just "stock"!

dialogues.speaker: Qasit
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Mamdouh
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Sorry buddy, our Aranara carvings have sold out for today.

dialogues.speaker: Ruhi
dialogues.text: Sold out? Oh no... I was gonna buy one for my cousin who's visiting tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Hey, how about this? You live near Razi's house, right? We'll deliver the new carvings to you first thing tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Ruhi
dialogues.text: Wow, thanks, Mr. Fayez! Don't forget, okay!

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: I promise. Acara Crafts would never let down a child!

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Ah, more customers. Sorry, our Aranara carvings have...

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: Oh hey, it's you guys. Thank you so much for your help. We've been planning on visiting you to express our gratitude, but as you can see... our store's been really busy.

dialogues.speaker: Fayez
dialogues.text: If it weren't for you, the store's anniversary might have been a different story.

choices.text: Looks like your business is doing very well.

response.speaker: Fayez
response.text: It's all thanks to Razi. He has so much creativity at such a young age.

response.speaker: Fayez
response.text: Oh, and we would like you to have the Prototype Aranara as a small token of appreciation.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Right, mind-blowing. It has a very... mysterious feel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... We appreciate your thought, but please give us some time to decide if we wanna keep it.

choices.text: Looks like the Aranara are really popular.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen

dialogues.speaker: Collei

dialogues.speaker: Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I-I thought we moved on from this topic! Um... it was just a coincidence!

choices.text: Collei looks kinda flustered all of a sudden.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I might have an idea about who that Mondstadter is.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I'll tell you more about it when we get the chance.

choices.text: I look forward to that day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The 20th aniversary of Acara Crafts is coming up. Paimon wonders what the children thought of the Aranara carvings we helped create! Let's go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that the toymakers' problems are resolved, let's go see how Tanger and Razi are doing!
